name: navigateSessionTab
description: Load what the person typed into the browser pane's address field in one of a chat session's tabs: a fixed-up http/https URL, else a default-search-engine query. Refused for a tab the session does not own.

inputs.name: sessionId
inputs.description: The owning chat session's id; the tab must carry its tag.

inputs.name: tabId
inputs.description: The tab's id as published in the session's tab list (the tab handle).

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The typed address or search terms, as entered.
